description: Load inline source with the installed runtime and list its declarations. Start here to find load errors; use caveat_check for authoring diagnostics and caveat_test to verify expected behavior. No events are dispatched. report (caveat-validate/0.1) contains program, loads, events, reading_streams, decision_series and displayed bindings, or a load error. exitCode: 0 loaded; 2 load failure. Returns the same JSON in structuredContent and text: {schema:"caveat-authoring/0.1",operation,sourceSha256,runtime,exitCode,report}. Read exitCode even when isError is false. Bridge failures instead set isError:true with {schema:"caveat-authoring-error/0.1",error:{kind,message}}.

source.description: Complete inline Caveat program text, available as the virtual file inline.cav. No file path or URL lookup. At most 1 MiB of UTF-8 source; each call uses a fresh runtime.

name: caveat_validate
